title: Synaptic gradients transform object location to action.

stimulation: 624-nm LEDs, total irradiance 500 W m-2 at the fly; 50-ms photostimulation for posture analysis (Fig. 1d-g); one stimulus per fly; flies raised on all-trans-retinal

mapping_basis: Paper name MDN is the MANC type name; driver MDN-1-Gal4 (VT44845-DBD; VT50660-AD) matches kit line MDN-1 -> MDN.
stimulation: 617-nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 5 s illumination within 9-s epochs (2 s baseline, 5 s light, 2 s off); 5 trials per fly; intensity not stated
sensory_condition: dark imaging chamber; tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill; 7 cameras at 100 fps
penetrance: behavioural-map region enriched for backward walking with MDN stimulation (Fig. 5B)

title: DeepFly3D, a deep learning-based approach for 3D limb and appendage tracking in tethered, adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Results '3D pose permits robust unsupervised behavioral classification'; Figs. 4-5; Figure 5-video 2; Methods 'Drosophila transgenic lines'
quote: Representative aDN>CsChrimson optogenetically activated antennal grooming.
mapping_basis: Paper's 'aDN-Gal4' is R76F12-AD; R18C11-DBD, which driver_lines.csv maps to DNfl023 (aDN2); an eLife.107450 kit row for the same hemidriver pair in reversed order (aDN2-spGAL4-2) gives DNg127/UNMAPPED, so confidence is medium.
stimulation: 617-nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 5 s illumination within 9-s epochs; 5 trials per fly; intensity not stated
sensory_condition: dark imaging chamber; tethered on air-supported spherical treadmill; 7 cameras at 100 fps
penetrance: behavioural-map region enriched for antennal grooming with aDN stimulation (Fig. 5C)
notes: This paper does not say which legs groom. Front legs coded yes because antennal grooming is defined in another room source (Hampel et al. 2020, eLife 59976, Introduction) as 'grasping and brushing of the antennae by the front legs'. Middle/hind legs not described, so unclear.
